RagShortTexts: Frankish warbands require food, crossings and guides.
Pursuit of Alamanni across rivers may provoke another power.

Variants.Content: Warbands need food, crossings and guides. Followers cannot leave farms indefinitely, and pursuit of Alamanni across rivers may bring a response from another side.

Frankish warbands require food, crossings and guides. These forces remain limited by food, rest and loads; vanguard speed does not represent the whole column. Pursuit of Alamanni across rivers may provoke another power.

Pursuit of Alamanni across rivers may provoke another power. Usable strength includes supply, home guards and exits; concentration reduces another reserve. Frankish warbands require food, crossings and guides.

Frankish warbands require food, crossings and guides. Fighters come from households; prolonged loss of labor or animals weakens the next levy. Pursuit of Alamanni across rivers may provoke another power.

Pursuit of Alamanni across rivers may provoke another power. Repair, carrying and care also use people, while daily supply continues after troops pass. Frankish warbands require food, crossings and guides.
